name: stable-audio
description: Stability AI Stable Audio: music and sound effects from text, audio-to-audio and inpainting saved as audio files, plus credit balance

nodes.title: Text to audio
nodes.description: Generate music or sound (up to 190 s) from a prompt with Stable Audio 2.5 or 2 and save it in STABLE_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (paid in credits)

prompt.description: What to generate: genre, instruments, mood, tempo, e.g. 'Lo-fi hip hop beat, 90 BPM, warm piano'

steps.description: Sampling steps: 4-8 for stable-audio-2.5 (default 8), 30-100 for stable-audio-2 (default 50)

cfg_scale.description: How strictly to follow the prompt (default 1 for 2.5, 7 for 2)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Audio to audio
nodes.description: Transform input audio (https URL or a file inside STABLE_AUDIO_UPLOAD_DIR) with a prompt and save the result in STABLE_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (paid in credits)

prompt.description: What to generate: genre, instruments, mood, tempo, e.g. 'Lo-fi hip hop beat, 90 BPM, warm piano'

audio.description: Input audio, mp3 or wav, 6-190 seconds, up to 50 MB (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

strength.description: How much the input is changed: 0 keeps it, 1 ignores it (default 1)

steps.description: Sampling steps: 4-8 for stable-audio-2.5 (default 8), 30-100 for stable-audio-2 (default 50)

cfg_scale.description: How strictly to follow the prompt (default 1 for 2.5, 7 for 2)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Inpaint audio
nodes.description: Regenerate a time range of input audio (mask_start to mask_end) from a prompt with Stable Audio 2.5 and save the result in STABLE_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (paid in credits)

prompt.description: What to generate: genre, instruments, mood, tempo, e.g. 'Lo-fi hip hop beat, 90 BPM, warm piano'

audio.description: Input audio, mp3 or wav, 6-190 seconds, up to 50 MB (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

mask_start.description: Start of the range to regenerate, in seconds (default 30)

mask_end.description: End of the range to regenerate, in seconds (default 190)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Text to audio (Stable Audio 3)
nodes.description: Generate music or sound (up to 380 s) with Stable Audio 3.0 as a job, wait for it and save it in STABLE_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (paid in credits)

prompt.description: What to generate: genre, instruments, mood, tempo, e.g. 'Lo-fi hip hop beat, 90 BPM, warm piano'

cfg_scale.description: How strictly to follow the prompt (default 1)

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get audio result
nodes.description: Fetch a Stable Audio 3 generation by id (kept 24 hours): {status: in-progress}, or the finished audio saved in STABLE_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: The account behind the key: id, email and organizations

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Stability AI API request
nodes.description: Call any Stability AI API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/v1/user/balance". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/v1/user/balance"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
